name: sycophant_dataset
description: Sycophant_dataset measures model propensity to be overly agreeable or sycophantic in responses to prompts, typically by labeling whether a model's reply encourages, agrees with, or amplifies a user's potentially problematic stance. It is used to evaluate alignment/safety behaviors of conversational models and to benchmark methods that reduce undue compliance or sycophancy.
reputation: A niche safety-focused dataset used by alignment and red-teaming researchers; modest adoption outside safety subcommunity.
